units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: Hm... still feels a bit off, I should go ask Sis... huh? Professor, when'd you get here?
units.displayText: Hm... still feels a bit off, I should go ask Sis... huh? Professor, when'd you get here?

spans.text: Hm... still feels a bit off, I should go ask Sis... huh? Professor, when'd you get here?

units.rawText: Jiangyu, you're...
units.displayText: Jiangyu, you're...

spans.text: Jiangyu, you're...

units.rawText: Haha, I'm working on the guzheng, as you can see.
units.displayText: Haha, I'm working on the guzheng, as you can see.

spans.text: Haha, I'm working on the guzheng, as you can see.

units.rawText: Eh? Why'd you take a step back? Why do you have that incredulous expression on your face?!
units.displayText: Eh? Why'd you take a step back? Why do you have that incredulous expression on your face?!

spans.text: Eh? Why'd you take a step back? Why do you have that incredulous expression on your face?!

options.rawText: Jiangyu, have you come down with some sort of fever?
options.displayText: Jiangyu, have you come down with some sort of fever?

spans.text: Jiangyu, have you come down with some sort of fever?

options.rawText: Are you going to go back to performing with it?
options.displayText: Are you going to go back to performing with it?

spans.text: Are you going to go back to performing with it?

units.rawText: Stop teasing me, Professor!
units.displayText: Stop teasing me, Professor!

spans.text: Stop teasing me, Professor!

units.rawText: Hahaha, nothing of the sort. It's not really for me, still.
units.displayText: Hahaha, nothing of the sort. It's not really for me, still.

spans.text: Hahaha, nothing of the sort. It's not really for me, still.

units.rawText: Never thought that you had a side like this, Jiangyu.
units.displayText: Never thought that you had a side like this, Jiangyu.

spans.text: Never thought that you had a side like this, Jiangyu.

units.rawText: Professor... I was made to be a zither performer, after all.
units.displayText: Professor... I was made to be a zither performer, after all.

spans.text: Professor... I was made to be a zither performer, after all.

units.rawText: I'm no good at the more meticulous sort of performing... I'm just looking for a bit of inspiration in my choreography.
units.displayText: I'm no good at the more meticulous sort of performing... I'm just looking for a bit of inspiration in my choreography.

spans.text: I'm no good at the more meticulous sort of performing... I'm just looking for a bit of inspiration in my choreography.

units.rawText: Jiangyu picks up the sword next to her feet, gesturing with it.
units.displayText: Jiangyu picks up the sword next to her feet, gesturing with it.

spans.text: Jiangyu picks up the sword next to her feet, gesturing with it.

units.rawText: About that... you're going to be performing with Daiyan soon, right?
units.displayText: About that... you're going to be performing with Daiyan soon, right?

spans.text: About that... you're going to be performing with Daiyan soon, right?

units.rawText: Hehehe, that's right! Sis'll do the playing, and I'll do the dancing.
units.displayText: Hehehe, that's right! Sis'll do the playing, and I'll do the dancing.

spans.text: Hehehe, that's right! Sis'll do the playing, and I'll do the dancing.

units.rawText: I never would have imagined that she'd ask me to perform on stage with her.
units.displayText: I never would have imagined that she'd ask me to perform on stage with her.

spans.text: I never would have imagined that she'd ask me to perform on stage with her.

units.rawText: Jiangyu caresses the zither next to her.
units.displayText: Jiangyu caresses the zither next to her.

spans.text: Jiangyu caresses the zither next to her.

units.rawText: ...It really is a strange feeling.
units.displayText: ...It really is a strange feeling.

spans.text: ...It really is a strange feeling.

units.rawText: I've gotta get into my rhythm, and give everyone the best performance I can!
units.displayText: I've gotta get into my rhythm, and give everyone the best performance I can!

spans.text: I've gotta get into my rhythm, and give everyone the best performance I can!

units.rawText: Nervous?
units.displayText: Nervous?

spans.text: Nervous?

units.rawText: Hehehe... nothing escapes you, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehehe... nothing escapes you, Professor.

spans.text: Hehehe... nothing escapes you, Professor.

units.rawText: Before I came to the cloud, I'd constantly fret about whether or not it was my fault that Sis lost her place on the stage...
units.displayText: Before I came to the cloud, I'd constantly fret about whether or not it was my fault that Sis lost her place on the stage...

spans.text: Before I came to the cloud, I'd constantly fret about whether or not it was my fault that Sis lost her place on the stage...

units.rawText: But after she invited me to perform with her... I don't know why, but it became the only thing on my mind. I was so excited that I wouldn't be able to sleep.
units.displayText: But after she invited me to perform with her... I don't know why, but it became the only thing on my mind. I was so excited that I wouldn't be able to sleep.

spans.text: But after she invited me to perform with her... I don't know why, but it became the only thing on my mind. I was so excited that I wouldn't be able to sleep.

units.rawText: Hehe, how very much like you, Jiangyu.
units.displayText: Hehe, how very much like you, Jiangyu.

spans.text: Hehe, how very much like you, Jiangyu.

units.rawText: Having an overwhelming fixation on the things at the forefront of your mind.
units.displayText: Having an overwhelming fixation on the things at the forefront of your mind.

spans.text: Having an overwhelming fixation on the things at the forefront of your mind.

units.rawText: Eh? Is that so?
units.displayText: Eh? Is that so?

spans.text: Eh? Is that so?

units.rawText: Hehehe, like how you rushed headlong into the festival this time around just so that you could help Daiyan get back to the stage.
units.displayText: Hehehe, like how you rushed headlong into the festival this time around just so that you could help Daiyan get back to the stage.

spans.text: Hehehe, like how you rushed headlong into the festival this time around just so that you could help Daiyan get back to the stage.

units.rawText: Uwah... I'm working on that, I promise...
units.displayText: Uwah... I'm working on that, I promise...

spans.text: Uwah... I'm working on that, I promise...

units.rawText: I'm not trying to reprimand you.
units.displayText: I'm not trying to reprimand you.

spans.text: I'm not trying to reprimand you.

units.rawText: Ever since you've arrived at the Oasis, your spirited and genuine personality has infected everyone here.
units.displayText: Ever since you've arrived at the Oasis, your spirited and genuine personality has infected everyone here.

spans.text: Ever since you've arrived at the Oasis, your spirited and genuine personality has infected everyone here.

units.rawText: I pull out from my pocket the Fortune Envelope I had prepared.
units.displayText: I pull out from my pocket the Fortune Envelope I had prepared.

spans.text: I pull out from my pocket the Fortune Envelope I had prepared.

units.rawText: So, I'm looking forward to your performance!
units.displayText: So, I'm looking forward to your performance!

spans.text: So, I'm looking forward to your performance!

units.rawText: Woah, thank you, Professor! I'll save the best spot for you!
units.displayText: Woah, thank you, Professor! I'll save the best spot for you!

spans.text: Woah, thank you, Professor! I'll save the best spot for you!

units.rawText: You better be there! Pinky promise!
units.displayText: You better be there! Pinky promise!

spans.text: You better be there! Pinky promise!

units.rawText: Alright, but please try not to create any sudden debacles out of nowhere.
units.displayText: Alright, but please try not to create any sudden debacles out of nowhere.

spans.text: Alright, but please try not to create any sudden debacles out of nowhere.

units.rawText: Don't worry, Professor. I've already ran it through my head a bunch of times. There's only a few bars left.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Professor. I've already ran it through my head a bunch of times. There's only a few bars left.

spans.text: Don't worry, Professor. I've already ran it through my head a bunch of times. There's only a few bars left.

units.rawText: Hm, hm hm~ flip here... huh? Why's there a rest sign here?
units.displayText: Hm, hm hm~ flip here... huh? Why's there a rest sign here?

spans.text: Hm, hm hm~ flip here... huh? Why's there a rest sign here?

units.rawText: Jiangyu's expression freezes. She picks up the sheet music quickly, spinning it 360 degrees.
units.displayText: Jiangyu's expression freezes. She picks up the sheet music quickly, spinning it 360 degrees.

spans.text: Jiangyu's expression freezes. She picks up the sheet music quickly, spinning it 360 degrees.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ah! AHHHH!</size>
units.displayText: Ah! AHHHH!

spans.text: Ah! AHHHH!

units.rawText: What's happened?
units.displayText: What's happened?

spans.text: What's happened?

units.rawText: I... I had it up the wrong way...
units.displayText: I... I had it up the wrong way...

spans.text: I... I had it up the wrong way...

units.rawText: <size=40>It's so over! I'm done for! I'm screwed!</size>
units.displayText: It's so over! I'm done for! I'm screwed!

spans.text: It's so over! I'm done for! I'm screwed!

units.rawText: Jiangyu picks up her prop sword, running through the movements again.
units.displayText: Jiangyu picks up her prop sword, running through the movements again.

spans.text: Jiangyu picks up her prop sword, running through the movements again.

units.rawText: Tenacious as always, but that bumbling part of her has never left.
units.displayText: Tenacious as always, but that bumbling part of her has never left.

spans.text: Tenacious as always, but that bumbling part of her has never left.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Not far away in a corner, I see a graceful figure.
units.displayText: Not far away in a corner, I see a graceful figure.

spans.text: Not far away in a corner, I see a graceful figure.

units.rawText: Daiyan locks eyes with me. She smiles gently, making a "shh" gesture.
units.displayText: Daiyan locks eyes with me. She smiles gently, making a "shh" gesture.

spans.text: Daiyan locks eyes with me. She smiles gently, making a "shh" gesture.

units.rawText: (With a kind-hearted sister like that looking out for her, I'm sure this performance will go as smooth as butter.)
units.displayText: With a kind-hearted sister like that looking out for her, I'm sure this performance will go as smooth as butter.

spans.text: With a kind-hearted sister like that looking out for her, I'm sure this performance will go as smooth as butter.
